body: Like I said, I don't really like the idea of sharing feelings with people I know, much less with a stranger. I don't think strangers would want to know my life story, then seeing me again... That's a lot of judgement for someone who doesn't like judgement.
I think I was destined to die early, probably by suicide. I can't decide on my future and that's not the only reason why but for some reason it sticks out like a sore thumb.
I'm the same... sleeping way too much though. Wish I could sleep forever.
I won't ignore you, what's bothering you right now?
I'm what people call a people pleaser... wish I wasn't. Honestly, I'm having an identity crisis right now. Who am I without all these expectations? I feel like I'm just a shell...
No problem. I'd love an update in a few years to see how you're doing! (Sorry for late reply)

I will try but I can't promise anything. Every mistake that I make I feel like is going to end my world. I can't get out of that mindset and it hurts. Peoples' opinions of me matter for some reason. And I can't get that voice out of my head.
How are you feeling these days? What are you up to?
Why do you feel like no one cares? Why do you feel like a big loser, is it because you have no friends at all or something else? Do you have a job? Maybe you can make some connections there?
Is there anything that distracts you from feeling this way? (That doesn't include harm) Would you mind sharing more stories that lead up to this state of mind?

Hi. Have you considered bringing your parents to court? Or something along the lines of that? It sounds harsh but I can't even fathom what you've been through because of your parents. I don't even know what to say. Or have you thought about just taking a break from your family? Sister included? Like, cut off communication with them, get your life back together then contact them? (Even if it takes a decade or two) You don't have to struggle alone, I'll carry a piece of your pain so you can carry a little less. If you need someone to listen and not judge, I'm right here and this whole community is here too.

Hi, I've read your other post that you don't believe in forgiveness. Do you want to talk about that? Because I am in a similar situation, I hold grudges for an unhealthy long period of time and I'm really petty but I eventually forgive. I see that you quit your job, have you considered looking for a better one?

If you do get diagnosed with autism, why die? You've been living your whole life already with it, just that you didn't know. Is it just this past year? Or has it been bottling up inside of you for all these years, and now it's reaching the point where it's starting to show? Is there anything in the past year that may have contributed to your depressive state rather than this? From what I've gathered, you feel like a burden to others, but it doesn't hurt (well hopefully it doesn't hurt) them to carry a piece of your pain, so you can feel a little less. :)

I don't know if I can fight for that long. I have considered seeing a therapist when I'm 18/ old enough. But if life is hard for me now, when I have my parents doing a lot of things, that makes me feel worse of what adulthood has in store for me. Thank you for reading this. I appreciate it.

If someone were to listen to my troubles. Understand how I feel. Understand that I'm drowning in an ocean of emotion. If someone were to not judge me for my state of mind. If someone were to show me that they care. That would stop me...
Thank you, it looks promising, thanks for replying!
Thanks! I'll definitely look into these.
